rationales.F03: Elevated LDH and CK are indicative of muscle damage, which is consistent with polymyositis, rhabdomyolysis, and ibrutinib-induced myositis.
rationales.F06: Elevated CRP, transaminases, CK, troponin I, myoglobin, and LDH suggest a systemic inflammatory process, which is consistent with polymyositis, myocarditis, and rhabdomyolysis.
rationales.F09: Muscle biopsy demonstrating interstitial and perivascular T-cell and macrophage infiltrates is highly suggestive of polymyositis and ibrutinib-induced myositis.
rationales.F10: Acute kidney injury secondary to rhabdomyolysis is a complication of severe muscle damage, which is consistent with rhabdomyolysis and polymyositis.
rationales.F11: Cardiac MRI confirmation of myocarditis is highly suggestive of myocarditis and inflammatory myopathy with myocardial involvement.
rationales.F12: CSF analysis showing elevated leukocyte count, lactate, and protein is consistent with myelitis and systemic inflammatory disease.
